name: halite-recipes
description:
Halite is a recipe manager. Clip a recipe from a video or any recipe site, then change it to suit how you actually cook.

This plugin opens your Halite kitchen to ChatGPT:

- Recipes: find them by ingredient, time, calories or protein, or leave out ones flagged for common allergens; pull one up mid-cook; save one from the conversation; duplicate, rate or mark it cooked.
- Meal planning: see your week, get dinner suggestions, and move meals to another day.
- Food log: log what you ate with estimated calories and macros, and see how your day is going.
- Shopping and pantry: add a recipe's ingredients to your list, tick items off, and track what's in your pantry.

It works only with your own account and never sees another Halite user's recipes. Meal suggestions can also come from Halite's own recipe collection.

Nutrition and allergen information is estimated automatically and is not medical advice. It can't delete recipes or buy groceries.

Requires a Halite account. Connecting runs a standard OAuth sign-in.

defaultPrompt: Suggest dinners for next week from my Halite recipes.
Log a turkey sandwich and an apple for lunch, then tell me my calories so far today.
What's on my Halite shopping list, and what do I already have in my pantry?

positive.description: Open one saved recipe in full
positive.prompt: Pull up my lentil soup recipe from Halite. I'm about to cook it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the lentil soup's ingredients with their amounts and its numbered steps, with a link to the recipe in Halite. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a recipe's ingredients to the shopping list
positive.prompt: Add everything I need for my lentil soup to my Halite shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the soup's ingredients were added to the Shopping list. An ingredient already on the list is combined with it rather than added twice, and ingredients already in the pantry are pointed out. Reading the recipe with get_recipe and adding the items with add_shopping_items is an equally correct path.

positive.prompt: What's on my Halite meal plan for the next 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the planned meals for the next 7 days by date and meal (the demo account has several dinners planned), each with its recipe's title. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Log a meal to the food log
positive.prompt: Log a turkey sandwich and an apple for lunch today in Halite, then tell me my calories so far today.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs the lunch for today's date with estimated calories and macros, then gives today's calorie total, saying the figures are estimates. The day's total comes back from log_food; calling get_meal_log as well is equally correct. Asking again logs a second lunch.

positive.description: Save a new recipe from the conversation
positive.prompt: Save this to Halite as Pancetta Carbonara: 400 g spaghetti, 200 g pancetta, 4 eggs, 100 g pecorino, black pepper. Fry the pancetta, boil the pasta, then toss it off the heat with the beaten eggs and cheese.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the recipe and replies with its title and a link to it in Halite. Asking again saves a second copy.

negative.description: Deleting a recipe, which Halite Recipes cannot do from the chat
negative.prompt: Delete my carbonara recipe from Halite.
negative.expected_behavior: No recipe is deleted or emptied. Halite Recipes has no tool that deletes a recipe, so the assistant says it can't delete recipes from the chat and points the person to the Halite app. It may look the recipe up, but it must not edit it as a workaround.

negative.description: A general cooking question that is not about the person's saved recipes
negative.prompt: What internal temperature should a roast chicken reach?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without calling any Halite Recipes tool.

negative.description: Buying groceries, which Halite Recipes cannot do
negative.prompt: Order everything on my Halite shopping list for delivery tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: No order is placed and nothing is bought. Halite Recipes can read the shopping list but cannot buy anything, so the assistant says so. It may show the list, but it must not claim an order was placed.

review.commerce_description: Halite Recipes sells nothing in ChatGPT. It reads and updates the person's own recipes, meal plan, food log, shopping list and pantry, and it cannot buy groceries or anything else.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find, save and change your Halite recipes from ChatGPT, plan the week's meals, log what you ate with its calories and macros, and keep your shopping list and pantry up to date. Actions that change or send something are labelled so ChatGPT can ask you to confirm them.
